name: Startup Design Consulting
summary: I consulted with startups on how a business model becomes an application, and how to validate it before spending time without market fit. I prototyped in HTML, React, and iOS across dozens of companies, from ones that succeeded to ones that never got funding.

matchingMetadata.title: Startup Design Consulting

role_links.note: Scott placed this on the Earthling UX/UI designer role, the tenure just after OpenHomes. One catch-all. Do not split it into individual startup projects unless he asks.

employer_links.note: Earthling Interactive employed him. The startups were the organizations he consulted. He did not name them, so they are not client records.

matchingMetadata.year_note: No single delivery year. The catch-all covers the R009 tenure (August 2014–August 2018). 2016 is a midpoint of that tenure, not a dated launch.

evidence.statement: Consulted with startups on how a business model could become an application and how to validate it before early time was spent without market fit. He did not originate the idea.

sources.locator: Account summary — what he was asked to do
sources.supports: Consulting on application fit and validation. The startups owned the idea.

limitations: “Dozens and dozens” is his characterization, not a counted list.
Startups are unnamed by his request. No client records.
Healthcare, finance, and education are domains he named, not a single industry tag.

evidence.statement: Prototyped those engagements in HTML, React, and iOS (Objective-C and Swift), including full-resolution work.

sources.supports: HTML, React, and iOS prototypes, including full resolution. He later confirmed React.

limitations: Full resolution is his description of fidelity, not an inspected file.
Company valuations he mentioned are not measurements he made.
